question: Which Indian personality has been appointed Regional Director for South Asia in the International Court of Arbitration of International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) in September 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tejus Chauhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lawyer Tejus Chauhan was appointed Regional Director for South Asia in the** International Court of Arbitration of the Paris-based International Chamber of Commerce (ICC)** in **September 2021**.​
 
• Tejus Chauhan is the second Indian appointed to the position and is based in Singapore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e44ce58f5b9b2a938ddec7b84f5edf8a996cfe901e4f974b7bdf4fe408fa1bdf.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• International Chamber of Commerce (ICC):

 
 
• ​ICC was founded in the aftermath of the First World War when no world system of rules governed trade, investment, finance or commercial relations.
 
• They called themselves **“The merchants of peace**”
 
• In 1923 ICC establishes the International Court of Arbitration.
 
• Headquarters - Paris, France.
 
• Secretary-General -** John W.H. Denton AO **
